recommendations.issue: WordPress Site URL Inconsistency (HTTP vs HTTPS)
recommendations.reasoning: Inconsistent protocol declarations between HTTP and HTTPS can confuse search engine crawlers, trigger unnecessary 301 redirects, and cause canonical mixed-content issues.

currentValue.structure: WordPress site_url is configured as "http://firstread.co.uk" (HTTP) while home is "https://firstread.co.uk" (HTTPS). This can cause plugins and REST API links to generate insecure URLs.

recommendedValue.structure: Ensure WordPress General Settings (WordPress Address URL and Site Address URL) both use https://firstread.co.uk. In Yoast SEO / robots.txt, ensure sitemap is declared with https://.

recommendations.evidence: WordPress site_url is configured as "http://firstread.co.uk" (HTTP) while home is "https://firstread.co.uk" (HTTPS). This can cause plugins and REST API links to generate insecure URLs.
recommendations.limitations: Changes to WordPress site settings must be executed manually by an authorized WordPress administrator.

recommendations.issue: Editorial Images Missing Descriptive Alt Attributes
recommendations.reasoning: Alt text assists screen readers for accessibility and allows Google Images to index and understand visual media.

recommendedValue.structure: Review the media in WordPress Editor and add concise, context-specific alt descriptions describing the illustration or diagram.

recommendations.evidence: Detected 1 elements with empty or absent alt attributes in rendered HTML.
recommendations.limitations: Alt text should accurately describe the image, not be stuffed with unnatural keywords.
